2086. Evaluating Relational and Logical Operators

60

Medium

Problem Statement
Read three integers and evaluate a compound condition using relational and logical operators, printing the result as 1 or 0.
Description
Read three integers a, b, and c. Evaluate the expression result - a greater than b and c greater than zero using relational and logical operators, without using an if statement. Since C treats true as 1 and false as 0, print the resulting value directly.
input_spec: Three integers a, b, and c, separated by spaces.
output_spec: Print 1 if the combined condition is true, otherwise print 0.
